evidence.detail: PersonMatches view only holds person and matches — no elo history attribute
Template shows a matches table with deck/opponent/result/date; no elo column or chart section
ALTER TABLE person ADD COLUMN elo INT — elo is a single current value on person, not stored per-match
adjust_elo() updates person.elo in-place with no historical snapshot; no elo_history table exists

triage.notes: Elo history can either be reconstructed by replaying all matches in chronological order per-person (expensive but no migration) or stored by adding an elo_before/elo_after column to the match table (migration required). Either path also needs a chart added to personmatches.mustache.
